title: RPG style map overhead view anyone?
content: I seem to always be travelling in these recurring dreams which have picked back up In the last few months. And besides the interdimensional airport my main method of travel seems to be zooming out to the “World Map” and then zooming back into the spot I want to be/am pulled to. Someone made a post about these places being “a little down the road” from places we used to know and that resonated super strongly. It’s always like that which makes me think more of dimension hopping than dreaming. The dreams are breaking through the THC fog so they must be intense
